name: std::strict_weak_order

declarations.code:
template <class R, class T, class U>

concept strict_weak_order = std::relation<R, T, U>;

intro: The concept strict_weak_order<R, T, U> specifies that the relation R imposes a strict weak ordering on its arguments.

sections.title: Semantic requirements
Notes
sections.text: The distinction between relation and strict_weak_order is purely semantic.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Check strict_weak_order for std::less<>, int, int.

summary: The concept strict_weak_order<R, T, U> specifies that the relation R imposes a strict weak ordering on its arguments.
